tagline: Fashion ramah lingkungan, dicetak oleh alam.
eyebrow: Tangerang Selatan · Ecoprint · Natural Dye · Sustainable Fashion

story.title: From leaves and natural dye into contemporary sustainable fashion.
story.body: Ageman Ecoprint was founded in Tangerang Selatan in 2021 as an environmentally conscious fashion label. Founder and CEO Ria Prawita, together with co-founder and fashion designer Anita T. Tanaem, develops fashion using ecoprint techniques, natural dyes and natural fibers. Public profiles of the brand also highlight zero-waste reuse, including turning production leftovers into craft, artwork or organic fertilizer.

highlights.title: Botanical printing
highlights.body: Leaves, flowers and other plant material are used to create distinctive ecoprint motifs directly on fabric.

highlights.title: Natural dye
highlights.body: Ageman has been profiled using natural color sources including indigofera and turmeric as part of its sustainable-fashion approach.

highlights.title: Fashion runway presence
highlights.body: Ageman represented Bank Indonesia Provinsi Banten at Kelana Wastra Fashion Fest 2024 with a sustainability-focused modest-fashion collection.

highlights.title: Circular production mindset
highlights.body: The brand has described reusing production waste for paintings, craft applications and organic fertilizer rather than treating it as disposable waste.
